title: x3d-blender-io 2.7.4 in bpy 5.3.0: a sweep of 514 real files
notes: Instruments: the x3d-blender-io add-on at 2.7.4 (commit c6063cb, merged to main as 0eb4809 by x3d-blender-io #77; the source tree is 92a942d at both) inside bpy 5.3.0 (Python 3.13): its importer, and its import followed by its export. Third instrument: x3d.py 4.0.65.8 as the add-on's validate.py at 2.7.4 calls it; a crash there is a crash of that pair, not of x3d.py alone.

The judge is the same as for 2.7.1 and 2.7.3: kit/loomkit/r2r/drivers/blender_io.py with tools/chaos of x3d-blender-io at 8e56437, the add-on source pinned to 2.7.4, under a 10 GB address-space cap. Cloud machine, 15 GB, 4 cores.

No chaos round is listed here. The chaos rounds on 2.7.4 belong to the add-on's own repository (docs/CHAOS.md, third round). This manifest exists so that the rules of earlier runs can be put to 2.7.4 with `r2r replay`.

Sweep: the same 514 files as for 2.7.1 and 2.7.3 (every .x3d under the project's repositories on 23 Nov 2026 that is at most 2 MB), named as repos:<repository>/<path>. Machine paths in the messages were replaced by <addon>/, <site-packages>/ and <x3d-blender-io>/; nothing else was changed.

To repeat: check the repositories out side by side, and give --root bpyenv=... (a venv with bpy 5.3.0 and x3d.py) and --root addon-src=... (the add-on source at each version under <version>/source). Rebuilding the probes of the 2.7.1 run also needs ../chaos unpacked from ../chaos-*.tar.xz.
